final: WITH totals AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, articount, 1.0 * articount / artifact_total AS share FROM scanfeatures CROSS JOIN totals), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, articount, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares CROSS JOIN totals CROSS JOIN averages WHERE artifact_total IS NOT NULL AND avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_minus_average IS NULL, share_minus_average DESC LIMIT 10
